title: Dissection of sample article
author: 64cf7168c6edd65797781320
chapter_outcomes: Students will be able to draft an article of 120-160 words with a clear purpose to persuade or inform the reader.
Students will be able to organize an article using a four-paragraph structure comprising an introduction, two body paragraphs, and a conclusion.
Students will be able to evaluate and select a structural route, deciding between a one-sided or two-sided argument.
Students will be able to formulate a hook, such as a question, to immediately grab the reader's attention.
Students will be able to paraphrase the overarching question to establish the topic within the introduction.
Students will be able to expand upon facts by adding connections, evidence, reasons, and depth to their arguments.
Students will be able to incorporate relevant examples to clarify and support their main points.
Students will be able to summarize their viewpoint in a conclusion using effective linking words rather than common clichés.
